profile.ja: 最強の対魔忍アサギと、ノマドの大幹部だった朧。互いに相容れない立ち場であるだけでなく、性格的にも反りが合わない。だが、実力に関しては認め合う部分もある。コンビを組んでみれば、意外と息の合う動きをするかもしれない。
profile.en: Igawa Asagi is the strongest Taimanin, and Oboro was a high-ranking executive of the Nomads. Not only do they hold irreconcilable positions, their personalities clash as well. However, they do acknowledge each other's abilities. If they were to form a duo, they might surprisingly work well together.

text.ja: 一時的とは言え朧と組むなんてね……　気分が悪いのは私の方だよ、さっさと終らせちまうよ！
text.en: Teaming up with Oboro, even temporarily… I'm the one feeling sick, so I'll finish this quickly!

text.ja: 現在ノマドとは協力関係にあるけれど、お前は信用できないわね　奇遇だねえ、私も対魔忍なんて信用してないから
text.en: I'm currently cooperating with the Nomads, but I can't trust you. What a coincidence—I don't trust Taimanin either.

text.ja: 最強の対魔忍も思ったより背が低いのは愉快だねえ　それは自分がでくの坊だという自己紹介かしら？
text.en: Even the strongest Taimanin is shorter than I expected—how amusing. Is that an introduction calling me a big kid?

text.ja: 最近ヨミハラの治安が少しマシになったと聞いたのだけれど？　なんだい？　暴れて欲しいってんなら、そう言いな
text.en: I heard Yomihara's security has gotten a bit better lately? What? If you want me to go on a rampage, just say it.

text.ja: お前の様な悪人に、あまり学生を近づけたくないわね　随分過保護なんだねえ。つけいる隙が増えるってもんだよ
text.en: I don't want a scoundrel like you getting any students too close. You're way too overprotective—it just gives you more chances to get caught.

text.ja: 私とペアなんて心強いでしょアサギぃ？　思ってもいない事を……反吐がでるわね
text.en: Having me as a partner must make you feel reassured, Asagi? The things you never imagined… it makes me want to gag.

text.ja: あはは、生徒の前でいい格好しようって張り切ってるわねアサギ♪　こういうときだけは奔放なお前が羨ましいわ朧
text.en: Ahaha, you're so eager to put on a good show in front of the students, Asagi♪ At moments like this I'm jealous of your carefree side, Oboro.

text.ja: 対魔忍のガキなんて興味ないけど、こいつは中々面白そうじゃないか　……こう言うヤツよ。油断してはダメよ？
text.en: I'm not interested in kid Taimanin, but this one looks pretty entertaining… That's the type. Don't let your guard down, okay?

text.ja: ほらほら校長さん、乳首が感じるんでしょう♪　よせっ、朧ぉ……！　んひあっ、ああっ、乳首敏感……抓るなぁ！
text.en: Come on, principal, you can feel my nipples, right♪ Stop it, Oboro…! Nnh, ah, my nipples are so sensitive… don't scratch them!

text.ja: 私はいい……オほおッ！？　でも生徒にはっ、手を出さないで！　ちゃんと先生やってるじゃない♪　余計に苛めたくなるわ♪
text.en: I'm feeling good… Ohh!? But students, don't lay a hand on me! I'm properly playing teacher♪ It just makes me want to bully you even more♪

text.ja: あははっ！　アサギが無抵抗に感じてる姿、興奮する♪　おンンンぅ！？　触ったらイクから、やめろぉおッ！　イクぅうッ！！
text.en: Ahaha! Seeing Asagi so defenseless gets me excited♪ Ooooh!? If you touch me I'll cum, so stop it! I'm coming!!
